title: [main] bug 652323 - Move creating VAT Period to setup demo data level
summary: Moved VAT Period creation from Master Data to Setup Data level in Czech Contoso demo data to ensure VAT periods exist when setup-level processes depend on them, removing downstream test workarounds.
key_points: VAT Period and VAT Return Period are now created at the Setup Data level instead of Master Data in Contoso CZ Localization
Fixes 'VAT Period does not exist' posting failures in newly generated CZ demo databases
Test Initialize Handler CZL no longer disables VAT date usage for codeunits 137161 and 139989, and its DisableVATDateUsage helper was deleted
E-Doc. Item Charge Tests no longer disable VAT Reporting Date Usage
Only demo data order changes; no schema, business logic or permission changes
